subject: First Application onto Shiny.io and having issues

messages.author: 330084ad16405bee
messages.subject: First Application onto Shiny.io and having issues
parts:
Hi All,
  Hopefully an easy question, but it's my first app here.

  I have an app that reads in a bunch of data, populates 2 dropdowns dynamically and then based on the choices displays a plot.  Pretty simple and straight-forward.

  Works fine on my local machine, but when I upload to the shiny.io site,   it appears to load the data, as the dynamic dropdowns do populate but when it attempts to draw the plot.. the screen just turns grey and the plot never appears.  

  What am I missing??  Like I said, works perfectly fine on my local machine.

  You can see it here if you'd like to look.  I will continue to play with it, but any guidance would be appreciated!

Thanks!!!

messages.author: 330084ad16405bee
messages.subject: Re: First Application onto Shiny.io and having issues
parts:
Got it working,  seems it was a memory limit issue.  I cut down on the amount of data I was using and it works fine now.

Thanks to anyone that looked!
